gate.required_result: user confirms facade proportions, street scale, MicroGrade, and LiDAR roof method are acceptable in game
gate.rule: Do not propagate the pipeline to the rest of the block until this gate passes.

locked_methods_after_gate: one shared photo-to-true-frame frontage scale where modern photo evidence contradicts per-address OSM splits
combined mapped outer footprint as geometry authority unless stronger evidence exists
LiDAR class-2 ground for longitudinal grade and local elevation
LiDAR/aerial/street-level cross-check for roof massing and height bands
Astra Microblocks 0.7.0 for evidence-driven sub-block geometry without a fixed host cap
full vanilla blocks for bulk mass where micro-resolution adds no fidelity
permanent EarthForge registration marker/orientation preserved across all exports
